item.title: MOH’s Proposed RM3b Budget Cut Risks Worsening Health Care Crisis: Galen Centre
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Galen Centre for Health and Social Policy CEO Azrul Mohd Khalib warned a RM3.06b MOH budget cut would mean longer waits, shortages, staff burnout, and preventable deaths. He said the cut would not even match the RM4b spent monthly on RON95 and diesel subsidies. item.title: Australia becomes the 30th country to eliminate trachoma as a public health problem
item.description:
Source: WHO News (Global Health)
The World Health Organization (WHO) has validated Australia for eliminating trachoma as a public health problem, marking a significant milestone in the health of indigenous peoples and in global efforts to combat neglected tropical diseases (NTDs). Trachoma, the world’s leading infectious cause of blindness, no longer represents a public health problem in the country.
